summary_en: CPerezz proposed banning SETCODEFROM in ERC-7562 (the 4337 validation rules), and EIP-8141 added EIP-1559 fee validity rules and a definition of effective_gas_price. Kassandra broke "privacy by default" into steps: first get every wallet to interoperate on basic stealth addresses, and before that, a post-quantum private scheme. L2BEAT launched a Blobs page and retired DABEAT because Ethereum has plenty of unused blob capacity.
